note: ADR 0004 and 0009: expected LLM fingerprints for live signals. Only IDs and facets are stored here. The harness reads each signal's title, summary and products from crdr_signal at test time, so no post text is committed. Written before the prompt exists, so this file defines 'correct'.

rules: Each expected group must be covered by one output group: every facet in it present, accepted (in the vocabulary and at or above fingerprint_confidence_threshold).
An output trigger facet that no expected group lists is a false positive and fails the case (it would create wrong exposures).
Extra in-vocabulary scope facets are tolerated (scope only narrows a match); 'forbidden' lists scope facets that would still be wrong.
A near miss passes when the output has no accepted trigger facets (or only those listed in 'allowed').

cases.description: Teams Interpreter agent is a Microsoft feature, but it bills through Copilot Credits usage-based billing, so tenants without a spending policy are affected. Was a near miss until T7 run 1 (2026-11-20) showed the post says so
Teams channel agents orchestrate via MCP: Microsoft's built-in agents, not makers' agents that use MCP. 'capability: uses_mcp' here would expose every MCP agent wrongly
Power Pages monitor hub: product scope only, no trigger
